$ rea inspect-byte-entropy --llms-full --format yaml

version: incur.v1
commands:
  - name: inspect-byte-entropy
    description: Inspect file-wide and block byte entropy without executing the file
    schema:
      args:
        type: object
        properties:
          path:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            pattern: ^[^\x00]*$
            description: Local file
        required:
          - path
        additionalProperties: false
      options:
        type: object
        properties:
          blockSize:
            default: 4096
            anyOf:
              - type: integer
                minimum: 256
                maximum: 65536
              - type: string
                pattern: ^0*(?:(?:2(?:5[6-9]|[6-8][0-9]|9[0-9])|[3-8][0-9]{2}|9[0-9]{2})|[1-9][0-9]{3}|(?:1[0-9]{4}|[2-5][0-9]{4}|6(?:0[0-9]{3}|[1-4][0-9]{3}|5(?:0[0-9]{2}|[1-4][0-9]{2}|5(?:0[0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-6])))))$
            description: Power-of-two block size from 256 to 65536 bytes
          offset:
            default: 0
            anyOf:
              - type: integer
                minimum: 0
                maximum: 9007199254740991
              - type: string
                pattern: ^0*(?:[0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|[1-9][0-9]{2}|[1-9][0-9]{3}|[1-9][0-9]{4}|[1-9][0-9]{5}|[1-9][0-9]{6}|[1-9][0-9]{7}|[1-9][0-9]{8}|[1-9][0-9]{9}|[1-9][0-9]{10}|[1-9][0-9]{11}|[1-9][0-9]{12}|[1-9][0-9]{13}|[1-9][0-9]{14}|(?:1[0-9]{15}|[2-8][0-9]{15}|900(?:0[0-9]{12}|[1-6][0-9]{12}|7(?:0[0-9]{11}|1(?:0[0-9]{10}|[1-8][0-9]{10}|9(?:0[0-9]{9}|[1-8][0-9]{9}|9(?:0[0-9]{8}|1[0-9]{8}|2(?:0[0-9]{7}|[1-4][0-9]{7}|5(?:0[0-9]{6}|[1-3][0-9]{6}|4(?:0[0-9]{5}|[1-6][0-9]{5}|7(?:0[0-9]{4}|[1-3][0-9]{4}|40(?:0[0-9]{2}|[1-8][0-9]{2}|9(?:0[0-9]|[1-8][0-9]|9[0-1])))))))))))))$
            description: Window start as a decimal file byte offset
          length:
            anyOf:
              - type: integer
                minimum: 0
                maximum: 9007199254740991
              - type: string
                pattern: ^0*(?:[0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|[1-9][0-9]{2}|[1-9][0-9]{3}|[1-9][0-9]{4}|[1-9][0-9]{5}|[1-9][0-9]{6}|[1-9][0-9]{7}|[1-9][0-9]{8}|[1-9][0-9]{9}|[1-9][0-9]{10}|[1-9][0-9]{11}|[1-9][0-9]{12}|[1-9][0-9]{13}|[1-9][0-9]{14}|(?:1[0-9]{15}|[2-8][0-9]{15}|900(?:0[0-9]{12}|[1-6][0-9]{12}|7(?:0[0-9]{11}|1(?:0[0-9]{10}|[1-8][0-9]{10}|9(?:0[0-9]{9}|[1-8][0-9]{9}|9(?:0[0-9]{8}|1[0-9]{8}|2(?:0[0-9]{7}|[1-4][0-9]{7}|5(?:0[0-9]{6}|[1-3][0-9]{6}|4(?:0[0-9]{5}|[1-6][0-9]{5}|7(?:0[0-9]{4}|[1-3][0-9]{4}|40(?:0[0-9]{2}|[1-8][0-9]{2}|9(?:0[0-9]|[1-8][0-9]|9[0-1])))))))))))))$
            description: Window length in bytes; omit to extend through EOF
          detail:
            description: Omit for complete Evidence when it fits the agent result budget
              (32768 compact JSON bytes by default, about 11k tokens) and its
              summary otherwise; complete always delivers everything; summary
              needs --evidence_output
            type: string
            enum:
              - complete
              - summary
          evidence_output:
            description: Save complete Evidence as a bundle; required for summary delivery.
              Never overwrites.
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            pattern: ^[^\x00]*$
        additionalProperties: false

  type: object
